world.title: U.S. pushes allies, China to back Trump’s economic war on Iran
world.summary: The U.S. has called on allies and China to support President Trump's economic campaign against Iran, emphasizing the need to isolate the Iranian economy. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that Washington aims to "collapse this regime" in Tehran. This warning comes amid escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran, highlighting the administration's commitment to its economic strategy.

world.title: Ex-Pak PM Imran Khan moved to private hospital from prison after SC order
world.summary: Imran Khan, the former Prime Minister of Pakistan, was transferred from Adiala prison to a private hospital in Islamabad following a Supreme Court order. This move comes amid ongoing health concerns, particularly regarding his deteriorating vision in his right eye. The transfer occurred after midnight on Thursday, marking a significant development in Khan's legal and health situation.

world.title: Houthis Move to Gain Complete Control Over Crucial Bab el-Mandeb Oil Chokepoint
world.summary: The Yemeni Houthis are advancing efforts to gain full control over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a vital oil chokepoint for global trade. This move could further threaten the strategic waterway, which currently experiences healthier traffic levels compared to the Strait of Hormuz. The information was disclosed by the Yemeni government's minister of information amid ongoing conflict in the region.

business.title: Informal search for new Tata Sons chief begins
business.summary: Noel Tata, chairman of Tata Trusts, has reportedly initiated an informal search for the eighth chairman of Tata Sons. He recently met with former HDFC chairman Deepak Parekh at the Taj Wellington Mew. This marks the beginning of the succession process for the leadership role within the Tata Group, following the tenure of the previous chairman.

business.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
business.summary: OpenAI is reportedly closing the gap with Anthropic in attracting business users, as companies shift between the two based on new model releases. This volatility raises concerns for investors regarding the stability of enterprise AI spending. Until financials are disclosed closer to their planned IPOs, insights from sources like Ramp provide indications of their business performance.

business.title: How Solar Panel Prices Fell 90 Percent In 15 Years
business.summary: Solar power became the fastest-growing energy source globally by 2025, largely due to a 90% drop in prices over 15 years. This decline resulted from early policy investments and a worldwide emphasis on energy security. Despite political shifts away from renewables in major economies, solar energy continues to expand rapidly, surpassing all other energy production methods.

technology.title: A beloved Pixel gesture just stopped working for some users
technology.summary: Some Pixel users have reported that a popular gesture feature has stopped functioning following recent updates. Despite Google's ongoing efforts to enhance device performance, this issue has emerged without a current fix. Users are expressing frustration as they rely on this feature for convenience. Google has not yet provided a timeline for resolving the problem or restoring functionality.

technology.title: Galaxy S26 FE Will Reveal Which Phones Get Samsung’s Free Upgrade
technology.summary: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE will determine which Galaxy phones will support Google's advanced AI, Gemini Intelligence. This new AI technology represents a significant advancement beyond traditional features, functioning as an agentic AI rather than a simple chatbot. Both Google and Samsung have not disclosed specific details about the S26 FE's AI capabilities, leaving users awaiting further information.

technology.title: GTA 6 leak mess deepens as second group surfaces with alleged internal build
technology.summary: A second group has emerged in the ongoing GTA 6 leak saga, claiming to have accessed internal Rockstar Games material by allegedly phishing an employee in India. This group has presented what it claims is a screenshot from an April 2026 build, along with development files and materials related to an Xbox development kit, complicating the situation further.

sports.title: ABF vs SNP Today Match Prediction and Betting Tips, Odds and Live Score
sports.summary: The Antigua and Barbuda Falcons (ABF) face the St Kitts and Nevis Patriots (SNP) in the Caribbean Premier League on August 21, 2026, at 04:30 IST. This match marks the first at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium for CPL 2026. Both teams are currently struggling, and the pitch is expected to provide a balanced contest between bat and ball.

sports.title: Brook's 91 gives England upper hand despite Ali Usman's five-fer
sports.summary: England gained a significant advantage in the Leeds Test against Pakistan, led by Brook's 91 runs. Despite Ali Usman's impressive five-wicket haul, which included three wickets in the last half hour, England managed to build a substantial lead. Four batters contributed with half-centuries, allowing the hosts to maintain pressure on Pakistan as the match progressed.

sports.title: India survives England’s onslaught, advances to the next round
sports.summary: India's women's football team secured a goalless draw against England, allowing them to advance to the next round of the World Cup. Despite facing significant pressure from England, the Indian team managed to hold their ground. The result was not ideal, but it was sufficient for India to progress in the tournament, demonstrating resilience under challenging circumstances.

health.title: BITS Pilani scientists develop novel bioink for 3D-printed tissue scaffolds and customised tablets
health.summary: Researchers at BITS Pilani have developed a novel bioink using low-cost, regulatory-approved polymers for 3D printing. This innovation enables the creation of living tissue scaffolds and chewable drug tablets, potentially transforming personalized medical treatments. The method leverages standard pharmaceutical materials, marking a significant advancement in tissue engineering and drug design, particularly for applications in skin grafting.

health.title: How highly aggressive colon cancer evades the immune system
health.summary: Researchers from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) and the HI-STEM Stem Cell Institute have discovered a new mechanism that allows a highly aggressive form of colon cancer to evade the immune system. This finding enhances the understanding of cancer behavior and could inform future therapeutic strategies. The research highlights the complexity of immune evasion in cancer biology.

health.title: At 15K blood tests/day, GMC lab sees surge in diagnostic workload
health.summary: Goa Medical College and Hospital's clinical biochemistry laboratory conducts approximately 15,000 blood tests daily, operating on a monthly budget of Rs 2.5 crore. The facility utilizes two advanced machines, each capable of performing 1,200 tests per hour. The laboratory manages routine biochemistry tests and immunochemistry, reflecting a significant increase in diagnostic workload at the institution.

science.title: From unicorn horn to scientific marvel: Narwhal tusk’s double spiral decoded
science.summary: Scientists have decoded the structure of narwhal tusks, revealing opposing spirals that contribute to their strength and resistance to bending and twisting. Historically, these tusks were mistaken for unicorn horns, believed to possess magical properties like poison neutralization and disease curing, making them highly valued by monarchs and nobles in the Middle Ages, often worth more than gold.

science.title: Chang'e-7: China's Daring Lunar Leap to Uncover Moon's Mysteries
science.summary: China is preparing to launch Chang'e-7, its most advanced lunar mission, focused on locating frozen water at the moon's south pole. The mission will feature a robotic lander, rover, and hopping probe. This initiative aims to support a permanent human presence on the moon, facilitating the development of a lunar base through international collaboration.

science.title: Microbes from Earth may survive on the moon, scientists find
science.summary: A new study suggests that microbes from Earth could survive on the moon's surface in a state of suspended animation. Researchers indicate that even small disturbances, such as a bootprint or rover tread, may create habitable areas for these microbes. This finding builds on previous research and highlights the potential for life to endure in extreme extraterrestrial environments.

entertainment.title: Irumudi - Box Office Collection Day 1
entertainment.summary: The film "Irumudi" collected ₹4.8 crores on its opening day across 1,252 shows. The daily box office analysis indicates a strong start for the movie. Additionally, "Vishwanath and Sons" has successfully connected the Tamil and Telugu markets, grossing ₹14 crores worldwide within its first week. Detailed box office collection and occupancy data are available on Sacnilk.

The guidance encourages embracing individuality while focusing on constructive outlets for energy, indicating a positive shift in personal development and self-awareness.

entertainment.summary: On August 21, 2026, Sagittarius individuals are encouraged to reflect on their inner conflicts.
